doc: answer a new query narrowed to exclude the specified component

name: UDim2
doc: a length on both axes, as a fraction of the parent plus a pixel offset

name: Rect
doc: an axis-aligned rectangle, from its minimum corner to its maximum corner

name: Min
doc: minimum corner coordinates

name: Max
doc: maximum corner coordinates

name: Width
doc: width of the rectangle along the horizontal axis

name: Height
doc: height of the rectangle along the vertical axis

name: Store
doc: a store kept with the place, so its rows survive a restart

name: get
doc: retrieve the record stored under key, or nil if no entry exists

name: put
doc: write a table record under the given key

name: CloudStore
doc: a store every server of the experience shares, read and written asynchronously

name: fetch
type: (self, key: number | string, callback: (any, number, string?) -> ()): ()
doc: load the record under key, invoking callback with data, version, and error

name: put
type: (self, key: number | string, value: {[string]: any}, expect_version: number?, callback: ((number?, string?) -> ())?): ()
doc: store value under key with optional expected version check

name: update
type: (self, key: number | string, transform: (any, number) -> any, callback: ((number?, string?) -> ())?): ()
doc: read and update the record via a transform function

name: remove
doc: delete the record under key

name: keys
type: (self, after: string?, limit: number?, callback: ({string}, string?) -> ()): ()
doc: list stored keys starting after cursor with optional limit

name: MaterialSpec
doc: the textures, pipeline class, and physical terms one material renders with

name: Id
doc: id the material is defined and looked up under

name: Name
doc: name the material can be looked up under, in place of the id

name: Pipeline
doc: pipeline class the surfaces draw in: Opaque, Cutout, Transparent, Water, or Decal

name: Model
doc: surface model the shader samples with: UV, Triplanar, or Stud

name: Surface
type: {BaseColor: string?, Normal: string?, Orm: string?, Tint: {r: number, g: number, b: number, a: number}?, TileSize: number?, NormalStrength: number?, RoughnessMult: number?, MetallicMult: number?, AlphaCutoff: number?, Neon: boolean?, TintVertex: boolean?}
doc: base color, normal, and ORM textures, with the tint, tiling, and multipliers applied to them

name: Emission
type: {Texture: string?, Tint: {r: number, g: number, b: number}?, Intensity: number?}?
doc: emissive texture, and the tint and intensity it radiates at

name: Studs
type: {ColorTop: string?, NormalTop: string?, ColorBottom: string?, NormalBottom: string?, StudsPerTile: number?}?
doc: top and bottom stud textures the Stud surface model draws

name: Water
type: {Absorption: {r: number, g: number, b: number}?, DepthScale: number?, Refraction: number?, FoamScale: number?, FoamDepth: number?, FlowSpeed: number?, FlowScale: number?, WaveAmplitude: number?, WaveScale: number?, WaveSpeed: number?, FlowMap: string?, Foam: string?}?
doc: absorption, refraction, foam, and wave terms the Water pipeline class solves

name: Physics
doc: density, friction, and restitution the solver gives the surfaces

name: Footsteps
doc: clips a character plays walking on the surfaces, and the gain and pitch spread they play at

name: Impacts
doc: clips a contact plays against the surfaces, and the gain and pitch spread they play at

name: Tint
type: {r: number, g: number, b: number, a: number}?
